sections.markdown:
## F — Avoiding Crashes
Research index: Avoiding Crashes; the main and continuation fact chunks contain 33 and 33 manually authored, page-anchored statements.
Physical-page coverage: 94 through 100, in handbook order.
VERIFY: ME-SEC09-COUNT — question count; ME-SEC09-PASS — passing standard; ME-SEC09-TIME — time limit.
VERIFY: ME-SEC09-MARKET — market pack; ME-SEC09-TEARDOWN — competitor teardown.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-ABS-CONFLICT — Resolve sustained-pressure versus pumping ABS instructions and non-ABS generalizations using current vehicle-specific authority before teaching emergency brake technique.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-IMPACT-BRACING — Review impact-bracing and unbelted body-position instructions against current restraint and airbag safety guidance.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-FIRST-AID — Clinical review required for CPR/rescue breathing, victim movement, bleeding-limb elevation, burn and shock instructions before detailed learner use.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-REPORT-CURRENTNESS — Verify current reportability threshold, scene duties and reporting exceptions; pinned handbook wording does not supply current legal signoff.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-VEHICLE-PROCEDURES — Verify equipment-specific brake-warning, parking-brake/engine-off failure, flooded-engine and jump-start procedures before generalized procedural instruction.
VERIFY: ME-CRASH-WATER-FLOAT-TIME — Verify vehicle-water escape guidance and reject reliance on the source floating-time estimate without current authoritative context.
Fact-check receipts in the worker scratch preserve all drafted fact ids and source-fidelity verdicts. Those same-model receipts do not substitute for independent QA.
